request:
Use case: compositing and identity-preserve. Output ONE finished 16:9 image, no board or contact sheet.

IMAGE 1 is the alpine terrace scene source and controls the camera, major geometry, mountain/lake/forest skyline, pavilion, bench, lamp, railings, central path, red canoe, and late-afternoon sunlight. IMAGE 2 is the only canonical Legacy MALE lion character authority, including illustrated rendering, facial structure, mane, build, black shirt/trousers/sneakers and tail. Every view on that sheet is the same character. Do not use scene objects as character references.

Add exactly ONE canonical male lion standing on the open foreground terrace, just left of the central path, in front of the pavilion's right edge without covering the lake canoe, bench or lamp. Show the full body with shoes grounded on the terrace. His height in the image should be about 60 percent of the frame height, making him a nearby presenter rather than a distant figure. His torso is in a familiar three-quarter view and face toward the viewer; one arm rests naturally at his side and the other makes a restrained open-palm gesture toward the lake. Keep his face, muzzle width, amber almond-shaped eyes, brows, layered golden mane and master body proportions. No oversized round eyes, fuller muzzle, larger mane, muscle inflation, new wardrobe, accessories, lettering or logo.

Maintain two intentional component mediums: the lion remains the master’s clean semi-realistic commercial mascot illustration with crisp contours and soft cel shading; the environment receives an authored premium CGI treatment with coherent stone, timber, glass, water and foliage, never flat cartoon surroundings. Preserve all the source's major scene facts and camera. Integration requires accurate scale, right-side warm illumination on fur and black clothing, physically plausible shadow cast leftward on the terrace, feet contact and subtle reflected stone light. Tail clearly attached and naturally curving without intersecting the legs or architecture. Do not make the character a photoreal animal or plastic 3D figurine.

Native Legacy environmental direction: warm highlights against cool/deep structure, restrained warm golden sunlight, readable charcoal contours where appropriate, polished commercial finish. Keep this recognizably the same alpine afternoon, with blue-green lake and forest, not a gold/black office. NO office furniture, brand marks or extra props. The rightmost lamp must retain its thin pole and rounded disk canopy, not become a square-headed lamp. Single red canoe stays on the lake near the right shore. Preserve the terrace central descent and rail gaps. Output the completed scene only.
preserve: Male identity, full-body integration, scene camera and major facts, disk lamp and red canoe
scope_boundary: One canonical character in a relatively simple target scene; this action is experimental until tested on fresh inputs.
